```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(Rnssp, tidyverse, ggplot2, gt, flextable, MMWRweek, janitor, patchwork, cowplot, scales)


#Load in myProfile for API pulls
load("~/myProfileNSSP.Rda")
myProfile <- myProfileNSSP

# Source the functions file -- should be updated for this version
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sara-chronister/synchron/refs/heads/main/R/get_longterm_data.R")
source("autotemplate_functions_LHJ.R")

# Read in geography crosswalk 
geogdf <- read.csv("Support Resources/WA_Geo_API_Crosswalk.csv")

geogdfnew <- geogdf %>%
  select(-EMS, -CDC_Facility_HSA, -CDC_Patient_HSA, -PHEPR) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
         State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
         StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
         ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
         RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
         LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = "")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!APIsyntax, names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::select(!Level) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

api_geog <- paste0(geogdfnew$APIsyntax, collapse = "")

geog_name <- params$geog # clean up a bit

# Read in Weather Station crosswalk
weather <- read.csv("Support Resources/Weather_Station_API_Crosswalk.csv")
weatherdf <- weather %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
         State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
         StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
         ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
         RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
         LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = ""),
         All_Geo = "All (May include patients outside WA)") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!c("APIsyntax", "Station"), names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::select(!Level) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

api_weather <- paste0(weatherdf$APIsyntax, collapse = "")


```

<!-- Parameters -->

```{r parameters}

# Dates
start_date <- params$start_date # Start date of reporting period for APIs
end_date <- params$end_date # End date of reporting period for APIs
end_date_neat <- format(params$end_date, "%b %d, %Y")  #re-format date for readability
start_date_neat <- format(start_date, "%b %d, %Y") 

# Data source

if(params$data_source == "Facility Location"){
  data_source = "&datasource=va_hosp&geographySystem=hospitalregion"
} else{
  data_source = "&datasource=va_er&geographySystem=region"
}

# Section Exclusions
include_falls <- !("Falls ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_MVC <- !("MVC ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_CO <- !("CO ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_asthma <- !("Asthma ED" %in% params$exclude_section)

```


<!-- Pull Weather Data -->

```{r weather, results ='hide'}
# Weather data API pull - Time Series

# Only pull the weather data if the selected geography actually has weather data in ESSENCE
if(nrow(weatherdf) > 0){

weather_ts <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?percentParam=noPercent&endDate=7Jul2023&userId=5695&weatherFactor=mintemp&datasource=va_weather_aggr&stationAggregateFunc=min&timeResolution=daily&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeAggregateFunc=min&startDate=6May2023", api_weather)

ts_weather <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(weather_ts, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)

ts_weather <- ts_weather %>%
  dplyr::rename(temp = count) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# Replace 0 with NA in the last row only
ts_weather[nrow(ts_weather), "temp" ][ts_weather[nrow(ts_weather), "temp" ] == 0] <- NA

}

```

```{r airquality, results ='hide'}

# Air Quality Data - Pull in a list of all WA stations
url <- "https://essence2.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails/csv?percentParam=noPercent&endDate=01Dec2023&airQualityParameterName=pm2.5-24hr&userId=1983&graphTitle=WA_Daily%20Max%20PM2.5&datasource=airquality&State=wa&stationAggregateFunc=max&timeResolution=daily&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeAggregateFunc=max&startDate=01May23"
airqualityOG <- get_essence_data(url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)

airqualityOG2 <- airqualityOG %>%
  mutate(APIsyntax= paste0("&airQualityStation=", Station),
         County = gsub("; WA", "", County),
         County = str_to_title(County))

# Join freshly pulled air quality data to the geography crosswalk table by county
    # We're doing this because we don't have an air quality crosswalk like we do with the weather temperature stations, so we're making one
geogdfaq <- geogdf %>%
  select(County, State, StateRegion,  ACH, RMO, LHJ, PHEPR) %>%
  distinct()

airquality <- left_join(airqualityOG2, geogdfaq, by = "County")

airqualitydf <- airquality %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
                State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
                StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
                ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
                RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
                LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = ""),
                All_Geo = "All (May include patients outside WA)",
                Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) %>%
  select(Date, Station, Value, County, State, StateRegion, APIsyntax, ACH, RMO, LHJ, PHEPR, All_Geo) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!c("APIsyntax", "Station", "Date", "Value"), names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

if(nrow(airqualitydf) > 0){
# keep max PM2.5 value each day for selected geography
ts_airquality <- airqualitydf %>%
  arrange(Date, Geography, desc(Value)) %>%
  distinct(Date, Geography, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(date = Date,  aq = Value)

# Replace 0 with NA in the last row only
ts_airquality[nrow(ts_airquality), "aq" ][ts_airquality[nrow(ts_airquality), "aq" ] == 0] <- NA
}

```

<!-- Pull Data Details -->

```{r denomdatadetails}

#ESSENCE data details fields to include
fields_list <-  list("Date","Sex", "AgeGroup", "c_ethnicity","c_race","Region", "HospitalRegion", "CCDDCategory_flat")

# Add &field= before each field
field <- paste(paste0("&field=",fields_list), collapse="")


dd_allcause <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails?startDate=16Dec2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=18Dec2025&percentParam=noPercent&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=DataDetails&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&refValues=true", data_source, api_geog, field)

dd_denom <- get_longterm_data(dd_allcause, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date )

```

```{r numdatadetails}

# Pull out all the condition-specific data details numerator data by CCDDCategory_flat
    # If there are no visits for one of the CCDD categories, will return data frame with zero rows
cri <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("Cold Related Illness v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

asthma <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("Severe Asthma v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

mvc <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("All Traffic Related v2", CCDDCategory_flat))

co <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("CDC Unintentional Carbon Monoxide Exposure v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

# Falls - pull own API (custom definition, edited CCDD but all ages)

falls_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails?startDate=22Dec2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&ccddFreeText=(,(,%5Erolled%20off%20bed%5E,or,%5Erolled%20out%20of%20bed%5E,or,%5Elos%5Ebalance%5E,or,%5Estumbl%5E,or,%5Eslip%5E,andnot,(,%5Edyslipidemia%5E,or,%5Epink%20slip%5E,or,%5Eslipped%20dis%5E,or,%5Eslip%20dis%5E,or,%5Edisc%20slip%5E,or,%5Eslipper%5E,),or,%5Etrip%5E,andnot,(,%5Eatrip%5E,or,%5Eamytript%5E,or,%5Etrip%20to%5E,or,%5Estrip%5E,or,%5Elithotripsy%5E,or,%5Etripod%5E,or,%5Ebus%20trip%5E,or,%5Etriple%5E,),or,(,%5Efall%5E,andnot,(,%5Efallopian%5E,or,%5Eno%20fall%5E,or,%5Edenies%20fall%5E,or,%20%5Edenies%20any%20fall%5E,or,%5Edenies%20recent%20fall%5E,or,%5Edenies%20any%20recent%20fall%5E,or,%5Ewithout%20fall%5E,or,%5Ew/o%20fall%5E,),or,%20%5Efell%5E,andnot,(,%5Ecatheter%20fell%5E,or,%5Etube%20fell%5E,),),andnot,(,%5Easleep%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW20%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DV80%5E,or,%5Eassault%5E,or,%5Eassult%5E,or,%5Ealtercation%5E,or,%5Efight%5E,or,%5Esuicid%5E,or,%5Eseizure%5E,or,%5Eheart%20attack%5E,or,%5Estroke%5E,andnot,%5Ehistory%20of%20stroke%5E,or,(,%5Eischemic%20attack%5E,or,%5Ecardiac%20arrest%5E,),andnot,%5E%5B;/%20%5DZ86%5E,or,(,%5Ecollision%5E,and,%5Evehicle%5E,),),),or,(,%5E%5B;/%20%5DV00%5B1-8%5D_1%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DV00.%5B1-8%5D_1%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW0%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW1%5B0-579%5D%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW16%5B01235678%5D_2%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW16.%5B01235678%5D_2%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW1642%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW16.42%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW1692%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW16.92%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW18%5B1-3%5D%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5DW18.%5B1-3%5D%5E,),),andnot,(,(,%5E%5B;/%20%5D%5BWV%5D%5B01%5D____%5BDS%5D%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5D%5BWV%5D%5B01%5D_.___%5BDS%5D%5E,),andnot,(,%5E%5B;/%20%5D%5BWV%5D%5B01%5D____%5BA%20%5D%5E,or,%5E%5B;/%20%5D%5BWV%5D%5B01%5D_.___%5BA%20%5D%5E,),)&endDate=23Dec2025&percentParam=noPercent&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=DataDetails&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&refValues=true", data_source, api_geog, field)

falls <- get_essence_data(falls_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date )
```

```{r}

# Pull time series data

timeseries_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?startDate=23Sep25&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=22Dec25&percentParam=ccddCategory&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&ccddCategory=all%20traffic%20related%20v2&ccddCategory=cdc%20unintentional%20carbon%20monoxide%20exposure%20v1&ccddCategory=cold%20related%20illness%20v1&ccddCategory=severe%20asthma%20v1&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&stratVal=ccddCategory&multiStratVal=&graphOnly=true&numSeries=4&graphOptions=single&seriesPerYear=false&nonZeroComposite=false&removeZeroSeries=true&startMonth=January&stratVal=ccddCategory&multiStratVal=&graphOnly=true&numSeries=4&graphOptions=single&seriesPerYear=false&startMonth=January&nonZeroComposite=false", data_source, api_geog)

all_timeseries <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(timeseries_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)
all_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  select(date,
         Percent = count, 
         alert_percent = color,
         Count = dataCount,
         alert_count = color_dataCount,
         Category = ccddCategory_id) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  ## NEW
  mutate(alert_percent = ifelse(alert_percent == "grey", "blue", alert_percent),
         alert_count = ifelse(alert_count == "grey", "blue", alert_count))

# Subset CCDD category time series
# If there are no visits for one of the CCDD categories, will return data frame with zero rows
cri_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "Cold Related Illness v1")

co_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "CDC Unintentional Carbon Monoxide Exposure v1")

asthma_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "Severe Asthma v1")

mvc_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "All Traffic Related v2")

#Falls
# If there are no visits for falls -- will still return a dataframe with a row for every day in your pull, just counts/percents will be zero!

# Time series falls -- percent

falls_timeseries_count <- falls_timeseries_count %>%
  select(date,
         Count = count, 
         alert_count = color) %>%
  mutate(Category = "Falls",
         date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  ## NEW
  mutate(alert_count = ifelse(alert_count == "grey", "blue", alert_count))
```

<!-- Summary Calculations -->

```{r calcs}

# Total CRI visits in report period
cri_visitcount <- nrow(cri)

# Create the CRI demographic table and pull summary metrics out from it
cri_table <- create_flextable(denomdf = dd_denom, numdf = cri, title = "CRI")

# Save the flextable object as a dataframe for manipulation
extracted_cri_table <- cri_table$body$dataset

cri_table2 <- extracted_cri_table[, 1:3]
cri_table2[c("Count", "Percent")] <- str_split_fixed(cri_table2[,3], " ", 2)
cri_table2$Count <- gsub(",",  "", cri_table2$Count ) # clean commas from count column, they don't play nice
cri_table2$Count <- as.numeric(cri_table2$Count) #make count numeric

max <- cri_table2 %>%
  group_by(Demographic) %>%              # Group by demographic field
  mutate(MaxCount = max(Count)) %>%    # Get max value in each group 
  filter(Count == MaxCount) %>%
  mutate(Percent = gsub("[()]", "", Percent))

agegroupmax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "AgeGroup"]
ageprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "AgeGroup"])
sexmax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Sex"]
sexprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Sex"])
racemax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Race"]
raceprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Race"])
ethnicitymax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Ethnicity"]
ethnicityprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Ethnicity"])

# Is CRI alerting?
percent_elevated <- any(cri_timeseries$alert_percent %in% c( "red", "yellow") )
 count_elevated <- any(cri_timeseries$alert_count %in% c( "red", "yellow") )
 
 if(percent_elevated == "TRUE" | count_elevated == "TRUE"){
   elevated <- "were elevated"
 } else{elevated <- "were not elevated"}

```

# `r if(params$geog != "All (May include patients outside WA)"){geog_name} else{"Washington State"}`
Winter hazards are defined as outdoor conditions, extreme weather events, or recreational activities and can cause various adverse health effects resulting in healthcare visits. This report contains weather data and analyses of healthcare encounter data for winter hazards, including suspected cold-related illness (CRI), asthma, carbon monoxide exposure related visits, slips and falls, and motor vehicle crash emergency department (ED) visits based on data reported to the Rapid Health Information NetwOrk (RHINO).

# Key Findings: `r start_date_neat` to `r end_date_neat`

CRI ED visits `r elevated` on at least one day during the reporting period.[^1] There were a **total of `r cri_visitcount` CRI ED visits**. The **`r agegroupmax` age group** had the highest proportion of visits (`r ageprop`). `r sexprop` of visits were **`r tolower(sexmax)`** patients. Patients of **`r tolower(racemax)` race** (`r raceprop`) and **`r tolower(ethnicitymax)` ethnicity** (`r ethnicityprop`) accounted for the most visits.

[^1]: Daily visit counts are considered elevated if values exceed what was expected statistically. See Data Notes for additional information.

# Cold-Related Illness (CRI)

Extreme cold may lead to CRI including hypothermia and frostbite, particularly in young children and older adults, and those who work or recreate outdoors. To reduce the risk of CRI, dress warmly, stay as dry as possible, and limit time outdoors when it is cold.

## CRI ED Visits Over Time

```{r cri_plot, dpi=300, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5, echo=FALSE}


p1 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = cri_timeseries,  metric = "Percent", alert= "alert_percent",  title = "Cold-Related Percent ED Visits", ylab = "Percent", weatherlab = "Min Temperature (F)", weatherfactor = "Temp") +
  theme(
      legend.position = "none", # no legend for first plot
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis text
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())  

p2 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = cri_timeseries,  metric = "Count", alert= "alert_count",  title = "Cold-Related ED Visit Count", ylab = "Count", weatherlab = "Min Temperature (F)", weatherfactor = "Temp") +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),  # Legend title font
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)) 

#Combine with shared x-axis
(p1 / p2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
  ) & 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())


```

# Data Notes

This report contains analyses of healthcare encounter data for seasonal hazards based on data reported to the Washington State Deparatment of Health's Rapid Health Information NetwOrk (RHINO). All non-federal hospitals across Washington State report healthcare encounter data in near real-time to RHINO. Data are preliminary and may change. Data reflect unique healthcare visits, and do not represent unique individuals.

Air quality data is obtained from regulatory monitoring sites managed and collected by regional clean air agencies and the Washington State Department of Ecology and provided by AirNow. The maximum PM2.5 concentration (ug/m^3^) on that day is displayed. Temperature data is obtained from the CF6 dataset maintained by the National Weather Service. Data reflects the minimum temperature recorded each day.

Red and yellow points on time series correspond to values that exceed what was expected statistically (alerts), with red indicating larger deviations. Bolded demographic bins in tables represent groups with statistically significant differences between condition-specific and all-cause ED visit counts, as determined by chi-square test standardized pearson residuals (significance threshold: residuals > 3).

For additional seasonal hazards information including more county-specific information, please see the public-facing RHINO [Seasonal Hazards Dashboard](https://doh.wa.gov/public-health-provider-resources/healthcare-professions-and-facilities/data-exchange/syndromic-surveillance-rhino/seasonal-hazards-dashboard).

## Visit Definitions

*If one of the below conditions is not included in this report, then there were no visits identified.*

**Cold-related Illness:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Cold Related Illness V1, using free text terms such as “cold exp,” “environmental exp” and “hypothe” and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (including X31, T68, T69, T33) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses. For more info see: [CRI Factsheet](https://knowledgerepository.syndromicsurveillance.org/cold-related-illness-cste).

**Unintentional Carbon Monoxide Exposure:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, CDC Unintentional Carbon Monoxide Exposure v1, using free text terms such as "carbon m", "CO pois" and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (including T58.0, T58.9) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses.

**Asthma:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Severe Asthma v1, using free text terms such as "asthma attack" or "asthma exacerbation" or diagnosis codes related to acute asthma (J45) or acute bronchospasm (J98.01) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses. For more info, see: [Severe Asthma Factsheet](https://knowledgerepository.syndromicsurveillance.org/sites/default/files/2025-07/Severe%20Asthma%20v1%20Factsheet.pdf).

**Falls:** These visits were identified through a modified version of the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, CDC Falls 65 and Older v1, using free text terms such as “trip” and “fall” and fall-related ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes among chief complaints and discharge diagnoses.

**Traffic:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, All Traffic Related v2, using free text terms such as “motor vehicle crash” and “car accident” and traffic-related ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes among chief complaints, admit reasons, and discharge diagnoses. Captures traffic-related visits involving pedestrians, cyclists, and/or motor vehicle occupants.
